performance_history.note: Grading Issue #3 (June 28), the most recent real send. There was a ~5 week gap between that send and this run (Aug 4), so publication last_7_days shows 0 opens/0 clicks/0 net new only because nothing was sent recently, not because of poor performance. Issue #3 itself performed well on a tiny list: 13 delivered (100% delivery), 46.15% open rate (6 unique opens, 10 total), 33.33% click rate (2 unique clickers), 0 unsubscribes, 0 bounces, 0 spam. Slot 1 carried a real Masterworks CPC ad; slots 2/3 were placeholders. What worked: high open and click rates and zero list attrition, so content and subject lines are landing. What did not: subscriber growth is stalled (13 active, down 1 from 14 at issue #1) and the long publishing gap likely cost momentum. Ad demand remains thin.

No prior real newsletter issue to grade. The only published post is a placeholder titled 'New post' (post_a6a02adf-dbc2-4b32-821f-74a7845965c0, published 2026-05-31), sent to a single test recipient. Publication baseline at run time: 14 active subscribers, +2 net new in the last 7 days, aggregate open/click rate 0.0% (no real campaign sent yet), earnings $2.24 (last 7 days). Use this as the baseline for grading issue #1 on the next run.
